memory_bridge: The Zen king retrieves compound On ゼン; every subject sheltered under the roof retrieves the complete native word 全て（すべて）.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 全部（ぜんぶ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The king sits peacefully under the shelter with his whole Zen kingdom intact: Zen → ゼン in 全部（ぜんぶ）, ‘all.’

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 全て（すべて）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Gather every last subject beneath the royal roof—nothing remains outside: 全て（すべて）, ‘everything.’

memory_bridge: At one public display, 発表（はっぴょう） supplies On ヒョウ; its outward face is 表（おもて）; a designer 表す（あらわす） an idea, while an image 表れる（あらわれる） by itself.

anchors.phonological_note: After the sokuon in はっ, ヒョウ surfaces as ぴょう.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 発表（はっぴょう）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Pin an announcement poster over the opening: 発表（はっぴょう）. 発 contributes はっ, and ヒョウ surfaces as ぴょう after small っ; the alternation is part of the real-word anchor.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 表（おもて）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Turn the garment over and inspect its outward face: 表（おもて）, “surface; front.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 表す（あらわす）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A designer deliberately pushes a symbol through the garment to 表す（あらわす） an idea—represent it.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 表れる（あらわれる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The growing shoot breaks through by itself and 表れる（あらわれる）—appears. This is the intransitive event.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 就是 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The capital summons its remarkable leader, who arrives 就是 at precisely the right moment; a seal drops onto jiù to certify ‘exactly so.’
